test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a circular race of 1600 m, A and B start from the same point and at the same time with speeds of 27 km/h and 45 km/h, respectively. After how long will they meet again for the first time on the track when they are running in the same direction?
solution:
**Given:**

In a circular race of 1600 m, A and B start from the same point and at the same time with speeds of 27 km/h and 45 km/h, respectively.

**Concept used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Relative speed is (45 - 27) × 5/18 = 5 m/s

Time will be, 1600/ 5 = 320 seconds

**∴ The correct option is 2**
